gaps.lead: The plane left the runway moments before the storm hit.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ the storm hit.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a moment before.

gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.

gaps.lead: People believe she was the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event: is thought to have + participle.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: The staff wear a uniform at all times.
gaps.sentence: The staff ___ a uniform at all times.

gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.
